chunks.label: Showing you're listening
chunks.rationale: Lets you keep a friend talking with short sounds of interest and surprise.
chunks.interference: Sou na no? asks 'really?'; sou datta n da means 'oh, that explains it'.

chunks.label: Agreeing out loud
chunks.rationale: Lets you say you think or feel the same.
chunks.interference: Watashi mo shares a fact or experience; doukan backs an opinion.

chunks.label: Reacting to their news
chunks.rationale: Lets you respond warmly to good news, plans and troubles.
chunks.interference: Tanoshisou (looks fun) gets mixed up with tanoshii sou da (I hear it's fun).

chunks.label: Keeping the story going
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask for the next part, the cause or the outcome.
chunks.interference: Nani ga atta no? asks what happened; dou natta no? asks how it ended.

chunks.label: Asking how things are
chunks.rationale: Lets you open a catch-up and turn the question back.
chunks.interference: Are kara (since that thing we both know) vs sore kara (and then).

chunks.label: Saying nothing much
chunks.rationale: Lets you answer catch-up questions without a long story.
chunks.interference: Toku ni is neutral; betsu ni on its own can sound curt.
members: 最近ちょっと疲れ気味

chunks.label: Asking what they did
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask about someone's recent free time.
chunks.interference: Nani shiteta asks what they were doing at a moment; nani shita asks what they did.

chunks.label: Checking on someone
chunks.rationale: Lets you show care about someone's health, work and new life.
chunks.interference: Daijoubu? asks about now; daijoubu datta? asks about something that's over.

chunks.label: Hobbies and favourites
chunks.rationale: Lets you find out what someone likes and does for fun.
chunks.interference: Dotchi picks between two; dore picks from three or more.

chunks.label: Pinning down details
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask what, since when, who said it and how they know.
chunks.interference: Dare kara kiita (who told you) vs dare ni kiita (who did you ask).

chunks.label: Asking about people
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask about the people in someone's life.
chunks.interference: Ii hito iru? means 'seeing anyone?', not 'is there a nice person?'.
members: どうやって知り合ったの？

chunks.label: Weather and season talk
chunks.rationale: Lets you open small talk with anyone through the weather.
chunks.interference: Mushiatsui (humid heat) vs plain atsui (hot).

chunks.label: Disbelief and letdown
chunks.rationale: Lets you react when news is more, or less, than you expected.
chunks.interference: Sonna koto aru? (how can that be) vs sonna koto nai (not at all).

chunks.label: Not really, it depends
chunks.rationale: Lets you play things down or avoid a flat yes or no.
chunks.interference: Sou demo nai (not really) vs soko made ja nai (not to that degree).

chunks.label: Granting a fair point
chunks.rationale: Lets you admit someone has a point.
chunks.interference: Sore mo sou da ne gives way; sore wa sou da kedo grants the point but pushes back.

chunks.label: Agreeing, then pushing back
chunks.rationale: Lets you disagree gently after granting something.
chunks.interference: Kimochi wa wakaru means you get the feeling, not that you agree.

chunks.label: Saying you disagree
chunks.rationale: Lets you disagree clearly and ask for reasons.
chunks.interference: Chigau means 'wrong' here, not 'different'.

chunks.label: Teasing and cheering
chunks.rationale: Lets you joke with, praise and comfort friends.
chunks.interference: Uso tsuke (yeah, right) vs uso tsuki (a liar).

chunks.label: Noticing a change
chunks.rationale: Lets you comment when someone looks different or happier.
chunks.interference: None.
members: なんかいいことあった？

chunks.label: Telling a story
chunks.rationale: Lets you build a story to its twist and wrap it up.
chunks.interference: Soshitara (and then, guess what) is livelier than the neutral sore de.

chunks.label: Time of year talk
chunks.rationale: Lets you chat about holidays, the year's end and time passing.
chunks.interference: Tatsu (time passes) sounds the same as tatsu (stand).
members: 早く週末にならないかな

drops.src: 休みの日は何してるの？
drops.reason: Duplicate of 休みの日は何してる？ (same question with an added no).
